commentary_title: VLGC rates rise on favourable arbitrage
commentary_summary: VLGC spot rates rise 6% WoW on the US-Japan route to an average of $140.17 per tonne in the week ending 10 May | Improved US-Asia arbitrage and lower Saudi LPG prices aiding fixing activity and demand | Competition for VLGCs rises at the Panama Canal as LNGCs and containerships increase transits | Asian LPG demand is still under pressure given the persisting negative PDH margins | Ballast tonnage volume rises in the Atlantic as VLGCs opt to move to the West through COGH for higher earning; also squeezing vessel availability
